## Twenty One Capital Purchases an Additional $10 Million Worth of Bitcoin, Increasing Holdings to Approximately 43,841 BTC


November 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-Purchases-an-Additional-10-Million-Worth-of-Bitcoin-Increasing-Holdings-to-Approximately-43841-BTC-2026.pdf)


*Adds 172.25 BTC, following its November 16 purchase of 154.32 BTC*


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Twenty One Capital, Inc. ("Twenty One" or "XXI") (NYSE: XXI) today announced the purchase of 172.25 bitcoin for $10 million, at an average purchase price of approximately $58,054 per bitcoin. The purchase was funded with cash, and brings the Company’s total holdings to approximately 43,841 bitcoin as of November 20, 2026.


“We purchased another $10 million of Bitcoin today, bringing our purchases this week to $20 million,” said Rapha Zagury, Chief Executive Officer of Twenty One. “Market downturns are part of Bitcoin’s history, and they create opportunities for investors with a long-term perspective. We have been deliberate about when to buy and the recent market decline gave us an attractive opportunity to put some cash to work. We’ll continue to build Twenty One with discipline and conviction.”


This purchase follows the company’s[November 16 announcement](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2Fnews%2Fnews-details%2F2026%2FTwenty-One-Capital-Buys-10-Million-of-Bitcoin-Increasing-Holdings-to-43668-BTC%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54644809&newsitemid=20261120202662&lan=en-US&anchor=November+16+announcement&index=1&md5=e34a25b12e5765b0f44ce3b49779a8a2) of 154.32 bitcoin, bringing total purchases across both announcements to 326.57 bitcoin. Twenty One plans to make additional Bitcoin purchases, which is core to the company’s strategy, with the amount and timing determined by market conditions, available liquidity, and competing investment opportunities.


**About Twenty One**


Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries in the public markets with operating businesses, Twenty One aims to provide shareholders with direct, capital-efficient exposure to Bitcoin through a growing Bitcoin-native platform. For more information, visit[https://twentyonecapital.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwentyonecapital.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54644809&newsitemid=20261120202662&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Ftwentyonecapital.com%2Finvestors&index=2&md5=d1654c043c763c6fdf5edf7ffb1756a8) .
